board.vocabulary: Module vocabulary: dense item ids in BoardStore with idOfKey/keyOfId (there are no nids and no onCapacityGrew; per-id arrays grow in lockstep in the store), TWO coordinate spaces (content and viewport-paint, plus track space for spans), the animation sources under BoardAnimationCoordinator (TrackResizeAnimator, ItemEnterExitAnimator, ItemSlideEngine, MakeRoomEngine), obtain-to-retain retention, OverlapLaneResolver lanes, the BoardDragController drag layer with BoardDropResolver, and BoardAnimationStyle families with a per-family zero kill switch. Where a lens focus names a sliver_tree construct (exit ghost, sticky pin, pending-deletion node, defunct scrollable), read it as the board analogue: an exiting item held by retention, a frozen track, an item mid-exit, an unlaid or detached port.

sliver_tree.vocabulary: Module vocabulary: nids and the *Nid hot-path variants, three coordinate spaces (sliver scroll, sliver paint, viewport scroll), five animation sources under AnimationCoordinator, exit and edge ghosts, sticky pins, pending-deletion nodes, TreeAnimationStyle families with a per-family zero kill switch.

correctness.addendum: In this codebase re-entrancy includes anything that can abort and re-run a layout, plus frame ordering and settle transitions. Teardown includes dispose, ticker cancellation and recognizer disposal. Degradation includes a zero-duration animation family (a kill switch that dominates explicit per-call durations), a defunct scrollable, a pending-deletion node, hot reload, and a mutation issued mid-animation, mid-drag or inside a batch.

performance.addendum: Hot paths that hash keys instead of using the *Nid method variants (sliver_tree) or the id-keyed reads (board). Per-frame allocation. Debug counters pin performance contracts here, so a plan names the counter and its expected value.

design.addendum: This package exports through explicit show clauses, so a symbol introduced without declaring its export is unnameable by app code. House conventions from AGENTS.md: double quotes except on imports, braces on every block, block bodies, no non-plain-text symbols anywhere. Every geometric value is tagged with its coordinate space. Debug counters and @visibleForTesting members are test seams.

interaction.addendum: Here the crossings are every animation source, paint pass, mutator, widget layer and entry point. A plan silent on what happens when its change coincides with a bulk animation, a reorder preview, an exit ghost or a sticky pin has not covered it.

timing.addendum: Here: a settle transition whose notify order is described but not asserted, a scroll correction whose re-entrancy is reasoned about but not exercised, a tick whose paint-only or layout-triggering status is claimed but not pinned by a debug counter. Running a frame is the test.
